decisions.reason: As a close extension of the firm's established finishing know-how, the cutting and creasing finisher fits its absorptive capacity and is therefore likely to be retained despite only limited market evidence so far.

Because the UV spot varnishing system is described as distant from the firm's established offer and the firm shows no clear in-house R&D base on the website, management is relatively likely to stop it if early learning remains difficult.
The sheet preparation module builds directly on the firm's existing modular finishing knowledge, which makes it easier to interpret feedback and improve commercially, so it is likely to stay.
The B2-format multifinisher system is close to the core portfolio, was highlighted on the home page, and strongly matches the firm's automation direction, so management would probably keep it.
A hybrid saddle stitcher is well aligned with the firm's booklet-making and postpress capabilities, giving the firm enough related knowledge to support continued market presence.
The folding add-on unit is very close to the firm's existing offer and already shows concrete customer use, which lowers uncertainty and supports keeping it on the market.
